### What problem does this PR solve?

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close #37892

Problem Summary: add  some metric by database 

### What is changed and how it works?
This pr is based on a modification of https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/38261
（We need to add a switch to control whether the db label is added to the metric or not.）

Reasons for not adding table labels: https://prometheus.io/docs/practices/naming/#labels

Add additional information about database name to the current metric 
tidb_server_handle_query_duration_seconds
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39378935/219271939-fc131f42-5001-47ae-87ba-133fafd1195f.png)

tidb_executor_statement_total
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39378935/219271653-3029aeae-f03b-4930-b59f-a494b7d574bd.png)

tidb_server_execute_error_total
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39378935/219271623-ec783bff-4589-42b0-8ed4-80145dbf66cd.png)

**Added a switch to control whether to add database labels**

```
[status]
record-db-label = true // default false
```

issue_context.title: Adding schema level information to tidb_server_handle_query_duration_seconds_sum
issue_context.body: According to https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/dev/performance-tuning-overview, TiDB already supported the metric `tidb_server_handle_query_duration_seconds_sum` to monitor processing time of queries from applications to TiDB. But when we shut down all our applications, it means there is no application query to TiDB, the metric still up and down in our dashboard. So it may turn out to be a mix of processing time for both application queries and TiDB internal queries. It should support other labels (beside: `instance`, `job`, `sql_type`) so we can filter between the sources of queries, for instance, may be `schema`, `table`. PTAL @xzhangxian1008 @xiongjiwei .

review_comments: Why do we need both `RecordQPSbyDB` and `RecordDBLabel`, it's confusing IMO.

I would prefer to deprecate `RecordQPSbyDB` and remove `DbStmtNodeCounter`. Users could use `RecordDBLabel` and `DbStmtNodeCounter` instead.

But we don't have to make it in this PR.
